# Open Library

> > An open, editable library catalog with over 3 million borrowable ebooks through Controlled Digital Lending, powered by Internet Archive.

Open Library serves as a comprehensive digital library catalog offering free book borrowing through BookReader, supporting multiple formats (PDF, ePub, DAISY), and integrating with WorldCat and LibriVox. The platform enables users to track reading goals, maintain reading logs, and contribute as volunteers to build the world's largest open library database.

## Key Topics

- Controlled Digital Lending
- Internet Archive
- BookReader
- ebook lending
- digital library catalog
- reading goals and logs
- volunteer opportunities
- WorldCat integration
- PDF, ePub, DAISY formats
- LibriVox audiobooks
- book editions and works
- author pages
- borrowing policies
- fantasy fiction collections
- Turkish translations

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to Open Library](https://openlibrary.org/): Homepage for Open Library digital catalog with 3M+ borrowable books

## Borrowing & Lending Help

- [Borrowing Books Through Open Library](https://openlibrary.org/help/faq/borrow): FAQ explaining book borrowing, lending policies, and BookReader usage

## Optional

- [Yedi Krallık Şövalyesi by George R. R. Martin](https://openlibrary.org/books/OL35304273M/Yedi_Krallık_Şövalyesi): Book edition page for George R. R. Martin's Turkish hardcover
- [Düşman Okullar 2 by Dilara Keskin](https://openlibrary.org/works/OL24328214W/Düşman_Okullar_2): Book work page for Dilara Keskin's Turkish novel
- [Congrès des psychanalystes de langue française des pays romans](https://openlibrary.org/authors/OL10717183A/Congrès_des_psychanalystes_de_langue_française_des_pays_romans_(52_28-31_mai_1992_Rome)): Author page for French psychoanalysis congress held in Rome 1992
